name: Assuming Gender
source: You are a guy sat at home with your sister. Every college has slammed their door in your face and it looks like this may be the end for your education until you’re enlightened by some news…. literally. The Gender-fluid movement. Can you use this new movement to your advantage?
translation: 你是个和姐姐（妹妹）一起宅在家里的男生。所有大学都把你拒之门外，眼看求学之路就要彻底断送，直到一则新闻让你醍醐灌顶……字面意义上的灵光一闪——“性别流动运动”！你能巧妙利用这股新兴风潮为自己谋取转机吗？
